meta.title: Privacy Policy — Varangian Venture
meta.description: How Varangian Venture collects and handles your data.

textarea.title: Privacy Policy
description: Just like I value my own privacy, I respect yours. I collect data only when it's necessary, and I handle it with care and transparency.
Your potentially sensitive information is safe with me. I won't share it with others unless you explicitly allow it or if the law requires it.

Any information you provide through contact forms, sign-up forms on my website, or via email is securely stored. Should you wish, I can delete any personal information you've shared with me upon request.

tools.title: Using Matomo and ConvertKit
description: For insights on website usage, I use Matomo, which means I have 100% control of all the data collected. Learn more by exploring Matomo's privacy policy.
Additionally, I use ConvertKit for managing newsletter subscriptions and communications. To understand how ConvertKit handles your data, please refer to their privacy policy.
If you have any questions or concerns about how your data is handled, feel free to reach out to me.
